about.label: About
paragraphs: For a year I was a full stack developer at a cybersecurity startup. I built the screens customers worked in, the services behind them, and the connections to six outside tools like Jira and GitHub. I also shipped an AI feature that turns plain text into search filters, and built the tests that checked its answers before launch.
Working with me is simple. You send the design, I tell you what it takes and when it's ready, and you hear from me before you need to ask.

services.label: Services
services.title: What you can hand me
services.lead: Say yes to bigger projects without hiring a developer. I test every screen size and hand it back ready to launch.

items.title: Design to code
items.body: Your Figma built to the pixel on every screen size, with the motion you designed, not a simplified version of it.

items.title: Forms, bookings and integrations
items.body: Bookings and forms wired to the payments, CRM and tools your client already uses.

items.title: AI and automation
items.body: Automations that answer leads and sort requests on their own, so your client stops copying data by hand.

services.terms: Fixed price before I start · Your client never sees my name · You own the code · Bug fixes for 30 days after launch

work.label: Work
work.title: What I can build for your clients
work.lead: Three concept sites built from Figma Community designs: a designer's file turned into a working site.

concepts.title: Luxury residential tower
concepts.body: The building told as you scroll, a live floor and apartment picker, and every lead sent to the sales team's CRM with an instant WhatsApp reply.

concepts.title: Product launch site
concepts.body: Motion that explains the product, a working "ask the product" AI chat, and demo requests that land in the CRM with an automatic email.

concepts.title: Boutique law firm
concepts.body: A calm, high-end Hebrew site with a step-by-step intake that sorts the case, books a consultation and follows up on its own.

featured.title: huntpilot
featured.body: My own automation tool. It checks company career boards on a schedule, filters out the noise and sends only what matters to Discord.
